content.content: When invoked as `deccy new` with an argument the form does not name — an unknown flag, a flag without its value, a second `-m <summary>`, or a bare word — the deccy CLI shall refuse the invocation, naming the argument.
content.rationale: The form names exactly one `-m <summary>` and repeated `--on <id>`; anything else is unparseable, and guessing at it would create births from invocations the caller did not write. Naming the argument keeps the refusal actionable without re-deciding the form.
